- **#4412** comes from the same note. It's a driver SMS prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.
- **PD-5302** comes from #central-random, where Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as a follow-up ticket from this week. He said no action is needed.
- **#8841 (possible)** comes from #central-random on 13 Oct. Tobias logged a Door 2 double-booking problem on "Tobias's dealer account." Marrow Fieldworks is the dealer account that changed hands in January, but no one in that thread names it, so I listed it separately.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because both belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. #central-team has no messages this week, so it added nothing.

Pree is a member of #central-random and #central-team. Ticket numbers are operational facts and Pree is on the Central team, so nothing here needed approval. Moss's note comes from GBrain (the shared notes store), not a public file. The brain search ran on keywords only, so a note that never uses the word "Marrow" could have been missed.
